blind.description: A stylized golden monstrance or sunburst reliquary. It features a stepped circular base studded with small red spherical jewels, a short contoured stem, and a circular head framed by thick, radiating rectangular sun rays. The center contains an opaque off-white or cream-colored circular insert visible from both front and back. The geometry is clean, continuous, and solidly modeled with no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: Seen from directly above, it appears as a thin horizontal strip showing the top rays of the sunburst rim spanning over the rounded base with tiny red studs, casting a clear scalloped gear-like shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the figure (roughly 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and about 1 foot wide.

match.reads_as: golden sun disc with rays on stem and foot

notes: footprint proportion 1.53x off the catalog (1.6 x 1.0 ft)
